set.body:
Owner-commissioned 2026-10-25 ("work on your half of plan"). Claude's half of the feasibility packet from the joint proposal (epic notes 20261025T140608.260924Z-p10810-c0000-rca0d-hddbbcf and 20261025T140809.851661Z-p16321-c0000-rec89-h9ebf19). Read-only and offline; no paid calls.
1. Missing inputs and anchors: measure whether UTF-16 word offsets for the assessor's speech records derive exactly from the transcript, and declare the annotation-run to media-part clock crosswalk.
2. Recall timing convention: establish from data lineage which TR numbering (Princeton or OpenNeuro) the recall-scene onsets use; if it cannot be established, no item is selected through that clock.
3. Scope cost per candidate scene (the scenes NN03 recalls): rows, vocabulary entries to review, refused speech, mention counts.
4. Frozen criteria draft: gate, two denominators, controls, discovery and confirmation split.
Deliverable: docs/plans/2026-10-25-identity-feasibility-inputs.md (content-free) plus local measurement artifacts under data/source-identity/feasibility/.
set.title: [evidence-binding] Feasibility packet, Claude half: inputs, clocks, scope cost, criteria
